summarize_constants_PRIMITIVE_TYPES: summarize the PRIMITIVE_TYPES set used to identify C primitive types in the MuJoCo WASM code generator
summarize_constants_SKIPPED_FUNCTIONS: summarize the SKIPPED_FUNCTIONS tuple that lists MuJoCo C functions excluded from WASM binding generation
summarize_constants_STRUCTS_TO_BIND: summarize the STRUCTS_TO_BIND list computed from introspect_structs minus skipped structs and plus anonymous structs
summarize_constants_FUNCTION_BOUNDS_CHEC: summarize the FUNCTION_BOUNDS_CHECKS dict mapping MuJoCo function names to their runtime size-check code
summarize_constants_MANUAL_STRUCTS_SOURC: summarize the MANUAL_STRUCTS_SOURCES tuple listing structs whose source code is generated by hand rather than automatically
